lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟੁ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaagad kot ihu jag hai bapuro ra(n)gan chihan chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: This wretched world is a fortress of paper, of color and form and clever tricks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨੑੀ ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਾਈਁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanhee see boo(n)d pavan pat khovai janam marai khin taaee(n) ||4||
lines.translation: A tiny drop of water or a little puff of wind destroys its glory; in an instant, its life is ended. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਉਪਕੰਠਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadee upaka(n)th jaise ghar taravar sarapan ghar ghar maahee ||
lines.translation: It is like a tree-house near the bank of a river, with a serpent's den in that house.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦੀ ਕਹਾਂ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ulatee nadee kahaa(n) ghar taravar sarapan dasai doojaa man maa(n)hee ||5||
lines.translation: When the river overflows, what happens to the tree house? The snake bites, like duality in the mind. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaaruR gur giaan dhiaan gur bachanee bikhiaa guramat jaaree ||
lines.translation: Through the magic spell of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, and meditation on the Word of the Guru's Teachings, vice and corruption are burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: man tan he(n)v bhae sach paaiaa har kee bhagat niraaree ||6||
lines.translation: The mind and body are cooled and soothed and Truth is obtained, through the wondrous and unique devotional worship of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai too sarab jeeaa(n) daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: All that exists begs of You; You are merciful to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tumhree saran pare pat raakhahu saach milai gopaalaa ||7||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary; please save my honor, O Lord of the World, and bless me with Truth. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੀ ਧੰਧਿ ਅੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baadhee dha(n)dh a(n)dh nahee soojhai badhik karam kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Bound in worldly affairs and entanglements, the blind one does not understand; he acts like a murderous butcher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੂਝਸਿ ਸਚ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta soojhas boojhas sach man giaan samaavai ||8||
lines.translation: But if he meets with the True Guru, then he comprehends and understands, and his mind is imbued with true spiritual wisdom. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun deh saach bin kaachee mai poochhau gur apanaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Truth, this worthless body is false; I have consulted my Guru on this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੯॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so prabh prabhoo dikhaavai bin saache jag supanaa ||9||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that God has revealed God to me; without the Truth, all the world is just a dream. ||9||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaatrik meen jal hee te sukh paavahi saari(n)g sabad suhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is pleased by the sound of the bell. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain babeehaa bolio meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The rainbird chirps in the night, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਲਟੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pri siu preet na ulatai kabahoo jo tai bhaavai saaee ||2||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, my love for You shall never end, if it is Your Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸਚ ਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: need gaee haumai tan thaakee sach mat ridai samaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Sleep is gone, and egotism is exhausted from my body; my heart is permeated with the Teachings of Truth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਖਂੀ ਬਿਰਖਂੀ ਊਡਉ ਭੂਖਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: rookha(n)ee birakha(n)ee oodau bhookhaa peevaa naam subhaaee ||4||
lines.translation: Flying among the trees and plants, I remain hungry; lovingly drinking in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: lochan taar lalataa bilalaatee darasan piaas rajaaee ||5||
lines.translation: I stare at You, and my tongue cries out to You; I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ਤੇਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: pri bin seegaar karee tetaa tan taapai kaapar a(n)g na suhaaee ||6||
lines.translation: Without my Beloved, the more I decorate myself, the more my body burns; these clothes do not look good on my body. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਂਉ ਬਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: apane piaare bin ik khin rahi na saka(n)u bin mile na(n)eed na paaee ||7||
lines.translation: Without my Beloved, I cannot survive even for an instant; without meeting Him, I cannot sleep. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: pir najeek na boojhai bapuRee satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||8||
lines.translation: Her Husband Lord is nearby, but the wretched bride does not know it. The True Guru reveals Him to her. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj miliaa tab hee sukh paaiaa trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||9||
lines.translation: When she meets Him with intuitive ease, she finds peace; the Word of the Shabad quenches the fire of desire. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tujh te man maaniaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||10||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, through You, O Lord, my mind is pleased and appeased; I cannot express Your worth. ||10||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਲੀ ਊਂਡੀ ਜਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhalee oo(n)dee jal bhar naal ||
lines.translation: The earth bends under the weight of the water,

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੂਗਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਗੜੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: doogar oochau gaR paataal ||
lines.translation: the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar seetal gurasabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maarag mukataa haumai maar ||1||
lines.translation: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai a(n)dhule naavai kee jot ||
lines.translation: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam adhaar chalaa gur kai bhai bhet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause||
